name: 結華
text:
やっりぃ！
エネルギー源ゲット～！
trans:
Woohoo!
My mana is fully restored~!

name: 結華
text:
チョコってば栄養食だし──
あは、それはさすがに言いすぎ？　でもさぁ
trans:
Who knew chocolate could be this nutritious!
Heh, well, maybe that's more of an exaggeration,
yeah? But anyways...

name: 結華
text:
プロデューサーからの、って思ったら
より元気が出る気がするんだよねぇ、三峰的には！
trans:
Whenever I know it's from you, it really does
feel like I'm given a boost. That's what Mitsumine
thinks anyway!
